SELECT
    ag.label AS age_group,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM mamba_fact_attended_visit v
         JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
              ON v.client_id = mdp.patient_id
         JOIN mamba_dim_age_category ac
              ON ac.code = 'MOH_105_OPD_DIAG'
         JOIN mamba_dim_age_group ag
              ON ag.age_category_id = ac.age_category_id
                  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, v.first_qualifying_encounter_datetime)
                     BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
WHERE v.first_qualifying_encounter_datetime >= ':startDate'
  AND v.first_qualifying_encounter_datetime <  ':endDate'
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ag.sort_order, ag.label, mdp.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, mdp.gender;

WITH confirmed_by_diagnosis AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            a.patient_id,
            a.date_created AS confirm_datetime
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_diagnosis a
        WHERE a.date_created >= ':startDate'
          AND a.date_created <  ':endDate'
          AND a.diagnosis_coded = 116128
          AND a.certainty = 'CONFIRMED'
          AND a.dx_rank IN (1,2)
          AND a.voided = 0
    ),

    confirmed_by_lab AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            o.patient_id,
            obs.obs_datetime AS confirm_datetime
        FROM conceptreview.mamba_dim_orders o
                 JOIN conceptreview.mamba_z_encounter_obs obs
                      ON obs.order_id = o.order_id
                          AND obs.voided = 0
                          AND obs.obs_datetime >= ':startDate'
                          AND obs.obs_datetime <  ':endDate'
        WHERE o.voided = 0
          AND o.order_type_id = 3
          AND o.fulfiller_status = 'COMPLETED'
          AND o.concept_id IN (1643, 200058)
          AND o.date_activated >= ':startDate'
          AND o.date_activated <  ':endDate'
          AND (o.date_stopped IS NULL OR (o.date_stopped >= ':startDate' AND o.date_stopped < ':endDate'))
          AND (
            (o.concept_id = 1643 AND obs.obs_value_coded = 703)
                OR
            (o.concept_id = 200058 AND (
                (obs.obs_question_concept_id = 32     AND obs.obs_value_coded = 703)
                    OR (obs.obs_question_concept_id = 200057 AND obs.obs_value_coded IN (200052,200053,200054,200055,200056))
                    OR (obs.obs_question_concept_id = 200051 AND obs.obs_value_coded IN (90075,90076,90077))
                ))
            )
    ),

    confirmed_any AS (
        SELECT patient_id, confirm_datetime FROM confirmed_by_diagnosis
        UNION
        SELECT patient_id, confirm_datetime FROM confirmed_by_lab
    ),

    treated_confirmed AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            c.patient_id,
            c.confirm_datetime
        FROM confirmed_any c
                 JOIN conceptreview.mamba_dim_orders d
                      ON d.patient_id = c.patient_id
                          AND d.voided = 0
                          AND d.order_type_id = 2
                          AND d.date_activated >= ':startDate'
                          AND d.date_activated <  ':endDate'
                          AND d.concept_id IN (99266, 165779, 165944, 165566, 165777, 243)
    )
